description: This file is a code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page 'ShowAns.aspx', handling display and submission of student answers and grades for a specific course, including database interactions via ADO.NET.

classes.name: ShowAns
classes.description: Partial class for the ShowAns ASP.NET page, managing display and submission of answers.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; retrieves student answers from database and populates UI controls.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates total marks, updates database with new marks, and removes student from course queue.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out user by redirecting to LoginPage.
